'''Renzfeil Neuwt''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], Captain Neuwt lost many soldiers to the growing menace of the Balmorran [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]]. In an attempt to counter the ravenous spread of these creatures, he has devised a gruesome plan to cut up and poison the bodies of his fallen troops. He tasked an Imperial spacer to place these poisoned body parts at the Colicoid feasting mounds in [[Bugtown]].
